theme: 教材字彙・中高階 750–850 第 54 群

items.pos: adv. 優雅地 | 簡潔地
items.colloc: dress elegantly 穿著優雅 | elegantly designed 設計簡潔
items.distinct: gracefully 優美地（強調動作）| neatly 整潔地
ex: The lobby is elegantly decorated with modern art.
大廳以現代藝術進行了優雅的裝飾。
She handled the difficult client very elegantly.
她非常優雅地處理了那位棘手的客戶。
This software solves the problem quite elegantly.
這套軟體以相當簡潔的方式解決了問題。

items.pos: n. 工程學 | 工程設計
items.colloc: civil engineering 土木工程 | engineering firm 工程公司
items.distinct: engine 引擎 | engineer 工程師
ex: Our engineering department is testing the new model.
我們的工程部門正在測試這款新機型。
Structural engineering is vital for this skyscraper.
結構工程對這棟摩天大樓至關重要。
The engineering design meets all safety requirements.
該工程設計符合所有安全規範。

items.pos: prep. 不包括 | 除...之外
items.colloc: excluding tax 不含稅 | excluding weekends 不含週末
items.distinct: including 包括 | except 除了
ex: The price is five hundred dollars, excluding tax.
價格是五百美元，不含稅。
Total revenue excluding the new branch is stable.
排除新分店後的總營收很穩定。
Participants are chosen excluding current board members.
參與者人選不包含現任董事會成員。

items.pos: n. 藉口 | v. 原諒
items.colloc: make an excuse 找藉口 | poor excuse 爛藉口
items.distinct: pretext 託詞（虛假理由）| apology 道歉
ex: Please excuse the delay in our shipment.
請原諒我們出貨的延遲。
He had no excuse for missing the meeting.
他沒有理由缺席會議。
Management will not accept any more excuses.
管理層不會再接受任何藉口。

items.pos: n. 因素 | 要素
items.colloc: key factor 關鍵因素 | risk factor 風險因素
items.distinct: element 要素（組成成分）| cause 原因
ex: Cost is a major factor in our decision.
成本是我們決策的主要考量因素。
Several factors contributed to the sales growth.
多項因素促成了銷售額的成長。
We must factor in the potential market changes.
我們必須將潛在的市場變化納入考量。

items.pos: adv. 微弱地 | 模糊地
items.colloc: faintly visible 隱約可見 | faintly smell 微弱氣味
items.distinct: vaguely 模糊地（抽象）| dimly 昏暗地
ex: The logo was faintly visible on the package.
包裝上的商標隱約可見。
He smiled faintly when hearing the news.
聽到消息時他微微一笑。
The office faintly smelled of fresh coffee.
辦公室裡隱約飄散著現煮咖啡味。

items.pos: n. 地板材料 | 鋪設地板
items.colloc: wooden flooring 木質地板 | install flooring 鋪設地板
items.distinct: floor 地板（物體表面）| ground 地面（室外）
ex: We need to choose durable flooring for the lobby.
我們需要為大廳挑選耐用的地板材料。
The new flooring was installed over the weekend.
新的地板已在週末鋪設完成。
Quality flooring significantly improves the office environment.
優質的地板能顯著改善辦公環境。

items.pos: v. 使驚嚇 | 使害怕
items.colloc: frighten away 嚇跑 | frighten someone into doing 脅迫某人做
items.distinct: scare 使害怕 | terrify 使恐懼（程度深）
ex: Don't let the sudden changes frighten you.
別讓這些突如其來的變動嚇到了。
The sharp drop in profit frightened investors.
獲利的急劇下滑讓投資人感到恐慌。
New regulations may frighten some small businesses.
新法規可能會讓一些小型企業感到擔憂。

items.pos: n. 敲擊 | v. 敲擊（hammer 的現在分詞）
items.colloc: constant hammering 持續的敲擊聲 | hammering away 埋頭苦幹
items.distinct: tapping 輕敲 | pounding 重擊
ex: The hammering noise is disturbing the staff.
敲擊的噪音正在干擾員工。
They are hammering out a new agreement today.
他們今天正在敲定一項新協議。
Constant hammering continued until the project finished.
持續的敲擊聲一直持續到專案結束。

items.pos: n. 處理 | 搬運 | 操作
items.colloc: careful handling 小心搬運 | handling fee 手續費
items.distinct: management 管理 | disposal 處置
ex: Proper handling of chemicals is strictly required.
嚴格要求對化學品進行適當處理。
The company charges a small handling fee.
公司會收取一筆小額手續費。
His handling of the public relations crisis was impressive.
他對公關危機的處理令人印象深刻。

items.pos: n. 傷害 | 損害 | v. 損害
items.colloc: cause harm 造成傷害 | do more harm than good 得不償失
items.distinct: damage 損壞（物體）| injury 傷害（人體）
ex: Overworking can do more harm than good.
工作過度往往得不償失。
The new policy will not harm our business.
這項新政策不會損害我們的業務。
There is no harm in asking for help.
尋求協助並沒有什麼壞處。

items.pos: v. 強調 | 凸顯 | n. 最精彩的部分
items.colloc: highlight the importance 強調重要性 | career highlight 職業生涯亮點
items.distinct: emphasize 強調（觀點）| underline 畫底線
ex: The report highlights a decrease in expenses.
該報告凸顯了支出的減少。
Please highlight the key points in the presentation.
請在簡報中標註重點。
The merger was a highlight of the year.
這次合併是年度的重要大事。

items.pos: v. 忽視 | 不理會
items.colloc: ignore the warning 忽視警告 | ignore the advice 不理建議
items.distinct: neglect 疏忽（該做而未做）| overlook 漏看
ex: We cannot ignore these customer complaints.
我們不能忽視這些客戶投訴。
He chose to ignore the email from the boss.
他選擇不理會老闆的電子郵件。
Ignoring market trends will lead to failure.
忽視市場趨勢將導致失敗。

items.pos: adj. 非法的 | 違法的
items.colloc: illegal act 非法行為 | illegal entry 非法進入
items.distinct: unlawful 不合法的 | criminal 犯罪的
ex: Using pirated software is illegal in this country.
在這個國家使用盜版軟體是違法的。
The contract was found to contain illegal clauses.
合約被發現包含非法條款。
It is illegal to dump waste in this area.
在此區傾倒廢棄物是違法行為。

items.pos: adj. 不可能的 | 難以忍受的
items.colloc: mission impossible 不可能的任務 | virtually impossible 幾乎不可能
items.distinct: improbable 不大可能的 | unattainable 無法達成的
ex: It is impossible to finish the project by tomorrow.
明天之前完成這個專案是不可能的。
Maintaining this schedule seems impossible right now.
目前要維持這個行程表似乎不可能。
The high standards make the job almost impossible.
高標準讓這份工作變得幾乎無法執行。

items.pos: v. 給...留下深刻印象
items.colloc: impress someone with something 以某事讓某人印象深刻 | deeply impressed 深受感動
items.distinct: express 表達 | suppress 壓抑
ex: Her dedication really impressed the board members.
她的敬業精神真的讓董事會成員印象深刻。
The candidate aimed to impress the hiring manager.
那位應徵者試圖給招募經理留下好印象。
I am impressed by your progress this month.
我對你這個月的進步感到印象深刻。

items.pos: prep. 包括
items.colloc: including VAT 含增值稅 | including meals 包含餐點
items.distinct: containing 包含（內容物）| comprising 由...組成
ex: The price is ten dollars, including shipping costs.
價格是十美元，包含運費。
Five staff members, including the manager, attended.
包括經理在內的五名員工出席了。
Our services, including maintenance, are fully guaranteed.
我們的服務包含維修在內都有完整保固。

items.pos: adj. 不可避免的 | 必然發生的
items.colloc: inevitable result 必然結果 | face the inevitable 面對現實
items.distinct: unavoidable 不可避開的 | certain 確定的
ex: Market fluctuations are an inevitable part of business.
市場波動是商業中不可避免的一部分。
The delay was inevitable due to bad weather.
由於天氣惡劣，延遲是不可避免的。
We must prepare for the inevitable changes ahead.
我們必須為即將到來的必然變化做準備。

items.pos: n. 機構 | 制度 | 習俗
items.colloc: financial institution 金融機構 | academic institution 學術機構
items.distinct: organization 組織 | establishment 建立；機構
ex: The bank is a major financial institution here.
這家銀行是當地主要的金融機構。
He works for a leading research institution.
他在一家頂尖的研究機構工作。
The institution has been serving the community for decades.
該機構已為社區服務數十年。

items.pos: n. 解釋 | 口譯 | 理解
items.colloc: different interpretation 不同解讀 | simultaneous interpretation 同步口譯
items.distinct: explanation 解說 | translation 筆譯
ex: We disagree on the interpretation of the contract.
我們對該合約的解釋有分歧。
The conference will provide simultaneous interpretation services.
研討會將提供同步口譯服務。
His interpretation of the data was highly accurate.
他對數據的解讀非常精確。
